questions.question: Dual tires should:
questions.explanation: When inspecting a vehicle, check that dual tires do not touch each other or any other part of the vehicle.

questions.question: The air storage tanks:

options.text: Hold air for only one braking action.
Hold enough air for brakes to work several times if the compressor stops.
Hold air only during an emergency.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold enough air for brakes to work several times if the compressor stops.
questions.explanation: Air storage tanks store compressed air for braking. They hold enough air so brakes work several times if the compressor fails.

questions.question: A slack adjuster should move no more than ____ from where it attaches to the push rod.
questions.explanation: Before a trip, check each slack adjuster after parking and setting wheel chocks. Pull the slack adjusters to make sure they move no more than one inch from the push rod attachment. If they move more, they need adjustment.

questions.question: If your brakes fail going downhill, decide quickly because:

options.text: The longer you wait, the faster your vehicle goes.
The longer you wait, the more vehicles move out of your way.
The longer you wait, the slower your vehicle goes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The longer you wait, the faster your vehicle goes.
questions.explanation: With brake failure on a downhill slope, act quickly. The longer you wait, the faster your vehicle moves, making it harder to stop.

questions.question: To help prevent rollovers, you should:

options.text: Keep the load near the back of the trailer.
Keep the load on one side of the trailer.

questions.explanation: To reduce rollover risk, load cargo as close to the ground as possible. Also take curves and corners slowly.

questions.question: To best reduce cell phone distractions while driving, you should:

options.text: Stay on one call for the entire trip.
Turn the phone off before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the phone off before driving.
questions.explanation: To avoid cell phone distractions, turn off your phone before starting a trip and leave it off until you arrive.

questions.question: What can rust around wheel nuts mean?

options.text: The nuts are the wrong size.

questions.explanation: Rust around wheel nuts can mean they are loose. If you see rust, check how tight the nuts are.

questions.question: If you feel sleepy while driving, you should:

options.text: Continue driving to finish the trip.
Drive faster to reach your destination sooner.
Pull over and take a nap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over and take a nap.
questions.explanation: If you feel sleepy while driving, the only safe choice is to stop and sleep. Fighting exhaustion is dangerous and causes crashes. Energy pills are not safe because they wear off and make you more tired than before.

questions.question: To prevent trailers from rolling over, a driver should do all of the following, except:
questions.explanation: To reduce rollover risk with trailers, drive slowly on turns and curves, and steer smoothly. Keep cargo as low to the ground as possible.

questions.question: A driver should test the tractor protection valve by:

options.text: Releasing air with the brake pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Releasing air with the brake pedal.
questions.explanation: Test the tractor protection valve by letting the air supply charge, turning off the engine, then pressing the brake pedal several times to release air. The valve should move to emergency position when pressure drops to an unsafe level.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a distracted person that motorists should worry about?

options.text: A driver talking to a passenger
A child on the side of the road
A construction worker on the side of the road
A person sitting on a bench waiting for a bus

questions.correctAnswerText: A person sitting on a bench waiting for a bus
questions.explanation: Be careful when driving near people who are not paying attention to the road. Watch out for construction workers, drivers talking to passengers, and children near the road.

questions.question: How do you release dolly brakes?
questions.explanation: Release dolly brakes by opening the air tank petcock. If the dolly has spring brakes, use the dolly parking brake control.

questions.question: When checking automatic transmission fluid, the vehicle:

options.text: Should be lifted with a jack

questions.explanation: The engine may need to be running to check the automatic transmission fluid level.

questions.question: When accelerating on a slippery surface like a wet road, a driver should:

options.text: Not worry about the road surface

questions.explanation: Accelerate slowly when driving on surfaces with poor traction.

questions.question: When should you slow down for a curve?
questions.explanation: Always slow to a safe speed before entering a curve. Slowing while in the curve could cause a skid.

questions.question: To prevent fatigue while driving, you should:
questions.explanation: A warm, poorly-ventilated cab makes you sleepy. Open a window, use a vent, or turn on the air conditioning to keep the cab cool and reduce fatigue.

questions.question: What is often found in compressed air?
questions.explanation: Compressed air in an air brake system usually contains water and compressor oil. These can damage the brakes if they build up. Drain the tanks regularly to remove this buildup.

questions.question: Class 1 hazardous material is:
questions.explanation: Class 1 hazardous materials are explosives. Examples include ammunition, dynamite, and fireworks.

questions.question: A ramp's posted speed limit:

options.text: Is safe for cars but may be too fast for large trucks
Is just a suggestion and can be exceeded

questions.correctAnswerText: Is safe for cars but may be too fast for large trucks
questions.explanation: Ramp speed limits are designed for cars. Large or heavily-loaded trucks may need to go slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: ____ is required emergency equipment.
questions.explanation: All commercial trucks must have emergency equipment. This includes spare electrical fuses, three red reflective triangles or flares, and at least one fire extinguisher.
